name: Clippy Portfolio Agent
description: A Clippy-themed RAG agent embedded on sharlenaluyen.com via a self-injecting clippy.js script. Uses the Anthropic API, with a Cloudflare Workers proxy to avoid exposing the API key client-side. Answers visitor questions about Sharlena using a sharlena-knowledge.txt knowledge base.

name: sharlenaluyen.com
description: Sharlena's personal website, built with Next.js and deployed on Vercel. Includes a custom Clippy-themed RAG agent, a blog, and a portfolio of Sharlena's work.

name: PostHog Agent
description: A PostHog agent that exposes Sharlena's work history, projects, and skills as queryable tools. Built to demonstrate agent-facing API design for the PostHog Product Engineer application.

name: PostHog Agent MCP Server
description: A remote MCP server exposing Sharlena's work history, projects, and skills as queryable tools. Built specifically to demonstrate agent-facing API design for the PostHog Product Engineer application.

name: PostHog Agent MCP Client
description: A local MCP client that connects to the PostHog Agent MCP Server. Built specifically to demonstrate agent-facing API design for the PostHog Product Engineer application.
